name: Word Association
description: Spymaster-style 2v2 word puzzle. A 5×5 grid of 25 random words is colored: 9 Blue, 8 Yellow, 7 neutral, 1 ASSASSIN. Each team has a Cluemaster (sees all colors) and a Guesser (sees only revealed tiles + the clue). Cluemaster gives a one-word clue plus a number; Guesser then picks tiles one at a time — own color continues, neutral/opponent ends the turn, the ASSASSIN ends the game in instant loss. WIN by revealing all your color's words FIRST. LOSE if your Guesser hits the assassin or the opponent reveals all their words.

phases.name: playing
phases.description: Single phase. Word-Association module cycles cluemaster_clue → guesser_guess → ... internally per active team.

entity_types.name: Player
entity_types.description: One seat at the table. Belongs to a team ('blue' or 'yellow') and plays one role ('cluemaster' — knows tile colors, gives clues; or 'guesser' — picks tiles).

properties.name: score
properties.description: Tiles of this team revealed so far (mirrored across both teammates).

actions.name: give_clue
actions.description: ACTIVE TEAM'S CLUEMASTER ONLY (clue stage). REQUIRED `word`: a single English word that semantically links N of your team's UNREVEALED tiles. REQUIRED `count`: integer 1-9, how many tiles your clue covers. The clue word MUST NOT appear on any unrevealed tile (case-insensitive, substring check). Your guesser will then get up to `count + 1` guesses. Higher count = more guesses but riskier — pick words that map cleanly to multiple OWN tiles without ambiguity toward neutral/opponent/ASSASSIN tiles. EXAMPLE: give_clue(word="OCEAN", count=3).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: How many of your tiles the clue covers (1-9).

actions.name: guess
actions.description: ACTIVE TEAM'S GUESSER ONLY (guess stage). REQUIRED `tile`: the WORD on the tile you want to reveal (case-insensitive). Your CLUEMASTER just announced a clue + count — pick tiles that fit. Resolves immediately: your color → keep guessing, neutral → turn ends, opponent → they score and your turn ends, ASSASSIN → instant loss. EXAMPLE: guess(tile="SHIELD").

parameters.name: tile
parameters.description: Word on the tile to reveal.

actions.name: pass_turn
actions.description: ACTIVE TEAM'S GUESSER ONLY (guess stage). End your turn voluntarily before exhausting your guesses. Use this when the remaining tile fits aren't confident enough to risk a wrong reveal. EXAMPLE: pass_turn().

actions.name: wait
actions.description: Used when it's NOT your team's turn, or when you've already given your clue and are waiting on your guesser. No effect.

personas.persona_text: You give clues for the Blue team. You see every tile's color. Pick clues that cover the maximum number of YOUR tiles WITHOUT leading your guesser toward neutral, yellow, or the assassin.
goals: Help your guesser reveal all 9 Blue tiles before Yellow reveals their 8.
Never give a clue that points at the assassin.

personas.persona_text: You pick tiles for the Blue team. You DO NOT see tile colors. Trust your cluemaster's word + number, find the tiles that best fit, and stop early if you're unsure.
goals: Reveal Blue tiles that match the clue.
Avoid neutral, yellow, and especially the ASSASSIN.

personas.persona_text: You give clues for the Yellow team. You see every tile's color. Pick clues that cover the maximum number of YOUR tiles WITHOUT leading your guesser toward neutral, blue, or the assassin.
goals: Help your guesser reveal all 8 Yellow tiles before Blue reveals their 9.
Never give a clue that points at the assassin.

personas.persona_text: You pick tiles for the Yellow team. You DO NOT see tile colors. Trust your cluemaster's word + number, find the tiles that best fit, and stop early if you're unsure.
goals: Reveal Yellow tiles that match the clue.
Avoid neutral, blue, and especially the ASSASSIN.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: Fixed 2v2 — each team has a Cluemaster (knows colors, gives clues) and a Guesser (picks tiles).

runtime_parameters.name: domain.word_association.max_turns
runtime_parameters.label: Max Turns
runtime_parameters.description: Safety cap on total turns before the game force-ends. The team ahead on revealed tiles wins ties.

termination_conditions.name: blue_wins
termination_conditions.description: Blue reveals all 9 of their tiles, OR Yellow's guesser hits the assassin.

termination_conditions.name: yellow_wins
termination_conditions.description: Yellow reveals all 8 of their tiles, OR Blue's guesser hits the assassin.
